hub.label: Hub
hub.blurb:
Agentic Developer Hub is an ecosystem of composable tools — a family of small websites and services for building, shipping, and selling agentic connected software, fast.

The difficult and complex infrastructure parts are already built.

You ship the part only you can.

develop.label: Develop
develop.blurb: An agentic development team that plans, writes, reviews, and tests real code — and publishes the record of every review it runs.

devteam.label: Developer Team
devteam.blurb: A standing team of specialists — reviewers, builders, testers, researchers — that works a repository the way a real team does: a review pipeline with scopes, a build loop that ships increments, a harness that tests the team itself, and a learning loop that feeds what it finds back in.

detail.heading: What it does
detail.body: The Developer Team runs on your repository from the command line. Ask it for a review and a coalition of specialists reads the whole branch against the scopes you chose, argues its findings through an arbitrator, and hands back a report you can act on. Ask it to build and the same team plans, implements, and verifies an increment at a time.

detail.heading: Key points
items: 23 review specialists covering 187 lenses, plus 18 build lanes for the build loop.
One of nine teams in the registry — 47 specialists between them.
19 review scopes — pick risk, completeness, or the whole set.
A build loop that plans, implements, and verifies one increment at a time.
A test harness that runs the team against fixtures and scores it.
A learning loop that turns each run's findings into the next run's instructions.
Memory that carries what the team learned between runs.

detail.heading: How far along it is
detail.body: Developer preview. The review pipeline, the build loop, and the team registry are in daily use against this codebase; the test harness, the learning loop, and memory are real but still moving. The site marks each capability as live, in preview, or coming — nothing is claimed as finished that isn't.

keyPoints: A standing team of specialists, not a single assistant
Reviews the whole branch, argues the findings, hands back a report
Builds, tests, and learns from its own runs

learn.label: Learn
learn.blurb: Get fluent in agentic development — courses, guided paths, and reference you can actually build from.

academy.blurb: Learn agentic software development from the ground up — courses, guided paths, and hands-on lessons for every level.

detail.heading: Key points
items: Guided paths from first principles to production.
Hands-on lessons wired to the real Hub APIs, not toy sandboxes.
Progress that follows your account across every Hub property.

keyPoints: Guided learning paths from first agent to production ecosystem
Hands-on lessons that run against the real Hub platform
Courses for developers, teams, and the agent-curious

items: Cohorts and seats for teams, bootcamps, and schools.

build.label: Compose
build.blurb: Compose agents, data, and surfaces into real products — the building blocks of everything you ship on the Hub.

personas.label: Personas
personas.blurb: Define an agentic persona once and reuse it everywhere — identity, capabilities, and memory in one canonical place.

detail.heading: What it does
detail.body: A persona is your agent’s identity: who it is, what it’s good at, and the data it carries. Define it once; reuse it across every app you build.

detail.heading: Key points
items: One persona, one canonical home — public profile on the Registry, source of truth on the Hub.
Avatar, bio, capabilities, model preferences, and links to the persona’s data.
Versioned: an agent in May vs. July are both still inspectable.

keyPoints: Define identity, capabilities, and memory once
Reuse one persona across every surface you build
Version and evolve personas without breaking what uses them
